answer: Because the raven stake is held until the anchor settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the haven audit lists each exposure. A farm running 72 keys as a result burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. An attester must stake 19% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
